title: Nine Lives High
description:
Explora un mundo donde el movimiento lo es todo y cada ciclo es único. En este viaje, se te conceden nueve vidas para alcanzar tu meta. Pero la muerte no es solo un final, es una transformación.

Haz el viaje a tu manera: Antes de empezar, puedes personalizar completamente a tu gato, eligiendo el aspecto que mejor se adapte a tu estilo.

Una vez que pierdes tu novena vida, el mundo que conocías desaparece. Al pulsar "Replay", no volverás al mismo lugar; el juego reinicia automáticamente tu aventura en un nivel completamente diferente, obligándote a adaptar tus movimientos ágiles a un nuevo entorno cada vez que vuelves a empezar.

title: Shadows of Christmas Eve
description: Explora una casa que se va transformando a medida que las pesadillas se vuelven cada vez más perturbadoras, mientras presencias parecen observarte desde la oscuridad. Descubre qué secretos se ocultan entre sus paredes antes de que sea demasiado tarde...

title: Block Block Block
description: ¡Diseña el espacio de tus sueños! En este acogedor juego de construcción, apila y organiza bloques de madera con formas únicas para crear encantadores dioramas. Diseña panaderías acogedoras, elegantes salas de estar o estudios peculiares, y crea hermosos espacios llenos de calidez y personalidad.

title: LION The Last Homeland
description: Un juego de acción Aventuras con Estrategia en tiempo real híbrida, encuentra y rescata a 20 niños en un MetroidVania repleto de enemigos desafiantes con combinación de combate de acción + ETR, plataformas y rompecabezas mientras reúnes a los últimos niños capaces de salvar a todo el universo.

title: Mind Keeper
description: Mind Keeper is a tower defense roguelite game where you construct your own stronghold, a representation of your mental integrity, and defend it from relentless waves of inner demons determined to destroy you.

Has entregado tu vida, y ahora debes abrirte camino desde sirviente desnudo hasta Rey fortificado. Gana salario, construye defensas y mejora tu base. ¿Sobrevivirás lo suficiente para matar a cada jefe putrefacto?

title: Umi Machines
description: Umi's machinesmust destroy the different tanks that are destroying Umi's worlds level by level. Every time players destroy20 tankson the surface, a multicolored one appears and fires a powerful beam into the sky to knock down our players. If the multicolored one isyellow, theLegendary Betaship is more effective at destroying it and advancing to the next level. If, on the other hand, the multicolored tank isblue, theLegendary Sigmaship is more efficient against it. To form the legendary ships, both players must simultaneouslypress the fire buttonandpush downthe joystick for the Sigma, and the same sequence with the fire andup arrowbuttons to achieve the combination of the Beta ship. Control of each legendary ship is taken by one of the players; if at any time they want to open the formation, they must both press the fire button and select the right direction to separate. They only have one life, so they have to be very careful when the multicolored tank starts firing its laser beam.

title: Cosmos
description:
Create a planet by keeping elements together with the power of gravity/anti-gravity of the sun and the moon! This is a 2 player game.

Keep all elements within the center of the screen to create the planet. You start with one element, but you get more as you keep them in the center. When you get all 4 elements, you will finally create the planet.

title: Lost Pages
description: Lost Pages is a small game I did for the Js13k Games 2020 competition. The theme for the competition was the HTML code 404. The game has it flaws but I fixed some bugs present in the JS13K upload (The biggest one was that animations were not playing properly). The game is about a librarian that finds a weird book in the library where she works. She grabs this book and suddenly is transported to another world. She now wields a scepter instead of the book and she must find all the book's pages to return to her world.

At the end of the band there is a detector that tests if your arepa is made as requested in the recipe. The game is a prototype, incomplete, but completely playable. Those who have played adventure games recognize the influence from a mini-game in Space Quest 4 :-)

Comienza con la supervivencia básica y alcanza el esplendor civilizacional.
